entry: Exact target sidebar row context menu: 在新窗口中打开

new_window_identity.numeric_window_identifier: local only; API opaque ID, not claimed as independently verified HWND

main_window.before: current initiating chat, different from target
main_window.after: same chat by visible title and refreshed RootWebArea

minimization.method: click verified new window title-bar minimize control
minimization.observed_result: new window no longer covers main window, remains enumerated; main current chat visible

focus.observed_foreground_effect: new window visibly overlays main window; main visible again after minimization
focus.interpretation: Includes tool latency and supervised inspection; not a measured OS focus interval, automatic minimization benchmark or upper bound. No zero-focus claim.

verification.kind: artifact/state/UI evidence assertions, not application unit tests

limitations: Already-loaded baseline; no notLoaded recovery or owner creation proof.
No programmatic loader backend added or watcher auto-load enabled.
No sustained owner retention, concurrent use, other DPI/language/client version or unattended business validation.
UIA had delayed/stale states before controlled action; fresh screenshots plus later matching semantics were used.
The new window is bound to the exact target independently of the unchanged pre-existing IPC owner.
No operating-system focus telemetry or IsIconic query.
failures_and_recovery: Default sandbox read-only IPC transport failed before methods; scoped approved probe succeeded.
Initial Git fetch failed DNS/reset; isolated fixed input was used and all 57 Git blobs later verified after a successful HTTP/1.1 fetch.
Pre-probe main chat changed during user activity while UIA lagged; causality was not assigned. A quiet interval and stable initiating-chat baseline preceded the one open action.
Current governance changed to 387c98a during preparation; fresh 17-check gate and full normative reads completed before opening.
redactions: raw screenshots and private chat histories
identity kernels, credentials and complete installed source
next_review: Alice: accept or reject this limited window-chain result; consider separately implementing the verified route in a default-off bounded backend. No merge or activation implied.
